name: François Duvalier
contribution: A Haitian politician, dictator and physician who served as president of Haiti from 1957 until his death in 1971.

checks.lead: François Duvalier (14 April 1907 – 21 April 1971), also known as Papa Doc, was a Haitian politician, dictator and physician who served as president of Haiti from 1957 until his death in 1971.
